description: This Java interface defines a functional contract for filtering header entries within a protocol adapter, allowing transformation or filtering (including removal) of header values based on specific logic.

classes.name: HeaderEntryFilter
classes.description: A functional interface for filtering header entries, which can transform or filter out header values based on custom logic.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the header filtering logic to a key-value pair, returning a possibly transformed value or null to indicate filtering.

methods.name: andThen
methods.description: Returns a composed filter that first applies this filter and then applies the subsequent filter to its result.
